events.title: .NET@Noon - Build Your First Real-Time Voice Agent
events.description:
**Agenda**
This will be a Zoom meeting at Noon

11:50am-12:00pm - Pre-Session Waiting Room
12:00pm-1:00pm - Presentation, JetBrains giveaway

**Build Your First Real-Time Voice Agent**
Real‑time voice agents sound simple in demos but fall apart the moment real users show up. Latency creeps in, people talk over the agent, accents and background noise wreck the transcript, and the whole experience slides straight into the uncanny valley.

This hands‑on session walks through building a production‑ready voice agent end to end using .NET, low‑latency speech‑to‑text, responsive LLM orchestration, and fast speech synthesis. You’ll learn how to handle barge‑in interruptions, reliably detect end‑of‑turn boundaries, and add empythetic emotional responsiveness that makes the agent feel natural without slowing it down.

5:50pm-6:00pm - Pre-Session Waiting Room
6:00pm-7:00pm - Presentation, JetBrains giveaway

**Building Deterministic, Accurate, and Cost-Effective AI in the Enterprise with a Semantic Layer**
Enterprise AI is probabilistic, but your business semantics shouldn’t be. A semantic layer makes meaning explicit so models and agents stop guessing what your data, APIs, and business concepts mean. That improves accuracy, reduces cost, and keeps multi-agent systems aligned without adding another brittle AI framework. The advantage isn’t a new tool—it’s designing systems where meaning is deterministic.
